note: Attacker-controlled include path (a WORD token whose value is a single '"' character, produced by the lexer from the escaped '\"' in the fuzzed sudoers input) is passed together with its length into expand_include.
The leading double quote is stripped unconditionally without verifying that olen >= 2; with olen == 1 the size_t length underflows to SIZE_MAX.
The underflowed SIZE_MAX is narrowed into int len, becoming -1, so the later memcpy size becomes (size_t)-1.
memcpy attempts to copy (size_t)-1 bytes from the 1-byte string at opath into the freshly allocated buffer: ASAN negative-size-param / out-of-bounds read-write crash.
